_about: Isooctane (1) + m-Xylene (2): isobaric bubble temperatures at 250.0 kPa (no vapour compositions are fitted). Rows: liquid mole fraction of isooctane, boiling temperature in K, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: Martins, V. D.[Vanessa D.], Granato, M. A.[Miguel A.], Rodrigues, A. E.[Alirio E.], Isobaric Vapor Liquid Equilibrium for Binary Systems of 2,2,4-Trimethylpentane with o-Xylene, m-Xylene, p-Xylene, and Ethylbenzene at 250 kPa, J. Chem. Eng. Data 59 (2014) 1499-1506
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 10, 11. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Fitted to the bubble temperatures alone (Barker's method): no set of this pair with vapour compositions passes the consistency point test, or none was measured. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.78 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
